items.q: Did GPT-6 prove the twin-prime conjecture?
items.a: No. [[finite-gap-not-twin]]. Infinitely many adjacent primes with gap **≤ 186**. Twin prime wants **2**. Same *kind* of theorem as Zhang's 70 million.

items.q: What did GPY already have, and why did it stall?
items.a: Gaps grow slower than **c log p** for any c > 0. Felt one hair from twins. Classroom: that method was already a **dead end**.
[[polymath-gap-compression]]. Tao's 博学者计划 + Maynard: **70M → 4680 → 600 → 246**. Then years of stall.

items.q: What is the 2026 news, if not gap 2?
items.a: [[follow-the-new-road]]. [[julia-stadlmann]] 246 → **240** (31 Aug). Classroom clock: three days later GPT-6 → **186**. A paper unlock, not a rumor sprint.
[[wait-for-the-deer]]. Zhang walks a backyard for a deer. No deer. A GPY tweak arrives. Eight years of dishes. Lecturer at 58. *Annals* in three weeks.

items.q: Why pair Zhang with 二舅?
items.a: [[play-a-bad-hand-well]]. Tao is the gifted-life foil. Most lives, 李 says, are 平凡而又充满波折. Du Fu: 庾信平生最萧瑟，暮年诗赋动江关.
